title: Feature Removal
description: A mod that aims at removing any feature or structure from the game the user configures.
body:
This is a basic mod intended to remove features or structures from the world generation.

In addition to replacing certain biomes with another biome, essentially removing the first biome from the world generation as well.

## Current functionality

Feature: 
- minecraft:desert_well

Structures:
- minecraft:trail_chambers
- minecraft:trail_ruins
- minecraft:ocean_ruin_warm
- minecraft:ocean_ruin_cold

Biome Replaced:
- minecraft:pale_garden -> minecraft:dark_forest
